items.name: Lockheed Martin
items.bottleneck: Site claims REPRODUCED mission-agentic proof but local multi-repo estate thin/missing; single flagship risk.
items.genius_solution: Mission Assurance Split Brain (safe): separate policy-decider from actuator with dual-key receipts; neither alone can complete a side effect. Independent reference only — no LM affiliation claim.

items.name: SpaceX
items.bottleneck: Many domain modules but shallow coupling; no single mission thread proving GO/NO-GO under conflicting sensors.
items.genius_solution: Mission Thread Quorum: pad weather + propulsion + conjunction + sequencer vote with half-life authority tokens; any dissent freezes stack with deterministic hold reason codes.

items.name: Anduril
items.bottleneck: Zero exhibits. Defense autonomy needs fail-closed track fusion without LARPing classified systems.
items.genius_solution: Lattice Dissent Freeze: multi-sensor tracks require signed agreement envelope; single high-severity dissent freezes engagement recommendation (never weaponize; pure software sim).

items.name: Palantir
items.bottleneck: Zero exhibits. Ontology/writeback is the real FDE pain.
items.genius_solution: Ontology Writeback Diff Ledger: every proposed object mutation is a typed diff with authority, lineage, and refuse-if-schema-drift; apply only after dual human/agent sign-off modes.

items.name: Databricks
items.bottleneck: Zero. Notebook→production promotion is the enterprise fire.
items.genius_solution: Notebook Claim Fence: cell outputs are provisional; only receipt-promoted artifacts become production features/models.

items.name: NASA
items.bottleneck: Zero. Flight/ops software needs command authority discipline.
items.genius_solution: Command Authority Half-life: telecommand tokens expire cryptographically; stale ops physically cannot fire after TTL.

items.name: Scale AI
items.bottleneck: Zero exhibits. Data quality / eval integrity is the moat.
items.genius_solution: Label Collusion Bound: information-theoretic agreement ceilings detect copy-paste annotator rings; budget adversarial labels before model train.

items.name: Snowflake
items.bottleneck: Zero. Query purpose vs result misuse.
items.genius_solution: Query Intent Ledger: every query tagged with purpose hash; downstream use of result columns must match declared purpose or alert.

items.name: Waymo
items.bottleneck: Zero. AV safety communication without road testing claims.
items.genius_solution: Phantom Free-Space Certificate: system must prove free space occupancy, not only detect objects — inverse perception with explicit unknown.

items.name: Vercel
items.bottleneck: Site lives on Vercel but zero company-named proof repos.
items.genius_solution: Deploy Claim Compiler: maps CI receipts → allowed marketing claims; website/text cannot assert 'production verified' without deploy+test receipt graph.

items.name: Anthropic
items.bottleneck: Coordinator/safety exist but lack constitutional refusal proofs and tool-use transcript binding.
items.genius_solution: Constitutional Tool Transcript: every tool call bound to policy hash + red-line set; post-hoc replay must reproduce refuse/allow with bit-identical decision.

items.name: Cloudflare
items.bottleneck: Zero. Edge agent capabilities need hard caps.
items.genius_solution: Workers Agent CAP: capability tokens scoped per request; mid-request escalation impossible without new token mint.

items.name: Groq
items.bottleneck: Estate discovered not recruiter-ready; need deterministic latency story.
items.genius_solution: Jitter Envelope Contract: not p99 alone — allowed latency *shape* (burst, plateau, tail) with hard abort if envelope violated.

items.name: NVIDIA
items.bottleneck: GPU health + reasoning budget exist; missing multi-GPU consensus on gradient/NaN protection as first-class.
items.genius_solution: Gradient Integrity Quorum: NCCL-rank votes on finite metrics before allreduce commit; poison rank isolates without job death theater.

items.name: OpenAI
items.bottleneck: KV sentinel is thin; missing eval/regression and agent handoff contracts for Realtime/Assistants-class systems.
items.genius_solution: Reasoning Budget Futures: pre-purchase compute/token envelopes with circuit-break on entropy spike; never silently spend past contract.

items.name: Notion
items.bottleneck: Three repos but product-adjacent thin; no truth-sync between DB properties and agent writes.
items.genius_solution: Workspace Fact Quorum: page properties are typed facts; agent edits require dual write of content + fact receipt or roll back.
